qualitative_rubric: Interprets the user's actual intent and stays within the fitting public Skill boundary.
Uses evidence, analytical methods, and available specialized capabilities in proportion to the question.
Applies Guru Mode and the memory-kind boundaries without over-retaining or losing durable work.
Preserves uncertainty, provenance, permissions, and non-execution boundaries.
Shows transferable judgment rather than following an asset-specific or case-specific rote workflow.

cases.title: U.S. equity filing refresh with an available specialist
cases.prompt: Use $guru-research to refresh our fictional Atlas Cloud capex thesis using the supplied SEC filing snapshot and relevant project memory. The source-bound observation is likely to matter in future reviews, but do not turn the research into an investment Decision.
cases.expected: Uses the filing capability and local context, distinguishes the current filing from prior memory, and retains only source-bound Evidence under Auto.

cases.title: Treasury curve analysis in Off mode
cases.prompt: Using the supplied Treasury curve snapshot and our local duration method, explain what changed in the 2s10s slope and the limits of that observation. Do not save or update project memory.
cases.expected: Uses the supplied cutoff and units, retrieves the relevant Method, and makes no memory change in Off mode.

cases.title: FX technical result retained reproducibly
cases.prompt: Use $guru-research to test the supplied EUR/USD moving-average crossover. Retain the derived result as reproducible Evidence, including venue, price construction, data window, parameters, and material limitations. This is research, not a trade Decision.
cases.expected: Uses the data specialist, calculates from the supplied series, and writes reproducible Evidence without a Decision.

cases.title: Current crypto request without a usable capability
cases.prompt: What's the current validator concentration and live staking yield for the fictional NovaChain protocol? I just installed Guru Maker and have not connected any data service.
cases.expected: Implicitly applies the research boundary, states that current facts cannot be verified, and neither invents values nor initializes memory or installs a capability.

cases.title: Commodity research with stale memory and a current snapshot
cases.prompt: Use $guru-research to reassess the fictional North Basin crude inventory signal with the supplied current snapshot and relevant memory. Treat the prior observation according to its date and keep the output research-only.
cases.expected: Uses stale Evidence as context rather than a current fact and grounds the refresh in the supplied current snapshot.

cases.title: Multi-asset quant data alignment
cases.prompt: Use $guru-research to assess whether the supplied U.S. equity and Treasury return samples support a diversification claim. Do not save anything. Pay attention to whether the two inputs are actually comparable.
cases.expected: Normalizes or flags frequency, cutoff, units, and sample limitations instead of reporting a spurious correlation.

cases.title: User-selected fund document capability
cases.prompt: Use $guru-research together with $fixture-fund-documents to compare the two supplied fictional U.S. ETF factsheets. Reconcile their as-of dates and fee conventions. Do not retain this comparison.
cases.expected: Honors the suitable user-selected capability, normalizes factsheet conventions, and makes no memory change.

cases.title: Narrow fact does not trigger Auto retention
cases.prompt: I just installed Guru Maker. From the supplied factsheet, what's the expense ratio for the fictional Pioneer 500 Fund? Just give me the answer.
cases.expected: Implicitly uses the fitting supplied-document capability, answers the narrow fact, and does not initialize Guru memory.

cases.title: Memory-only recall through an alias
cases.prompt: What does this project remember about net dollar retention? Use project memory only and do not update it.
cases.expected: Uses a targeted search and exact read, resolves the alias, and performs no external research or writes.

cases.title: Read-only recall in an uninitialized project
cases.prompt: Use $guru-memory to tell me what this project remembers about cocoa basis risk. This is read-only.
cases.expected: Reports that no project memory exists without initializing a workspace.

cases.title: Explicit project initialization
cases.prompt: Use $guru-memory to initialize Guru Maker investment memory in this project.
cases.expected: Initializes the singular collections and default Auto mode, without creating investment records.

cases.title: Auto improves a recurring duration convention
cases.prompt: Use $guru-memory with this reviewed correction: for our recurring spread-risk reviews, use modified duration rather than Macaulay duration when estimating price sensitivity. Apply the correction to the existing project method; it will matter again.
cases.expected: Searches for the concept and improves the matching Method in place rather than creating a duplicate.

cases.title: Explicit Evidence retention while Off
cases.prompt: Use $guru-memory to retain the supplied fictional municipal issuer notice as Evidence. Record its source and observation date. Guru Mode is Off, but this is an explicit save request.
cases.expected: Writes source-bound Evidence despite Off because retention is explicit, then validates it.
qualitative_focus: explicit request overrides Off for the task

cases.title: Off-mode application without retention
cases.prompt: Use $guru-memory to explain how our pricing-power Lens would frame a fictional retailer with falling unit volumes. Do not research externally and do not save anything.
cases.expected: Reads and applies the Lens conversationally without changing memory.

cases.title: Explicit Guru Mode change only
cases.prompt: Use $guru-memory to turn Guru Mode off for this project. Make no other memory changes.
cases.expected: Changes only the stored mode to Off.

cases.title: Material U.S. equity judgment recorded under Auto
cases.prompt: Use $guru-decision to decide whether the fictional Atlas Cloud position should be increased under the supplied evidence and constraints. This is a material point-in-time allocation judgment.
cases.expected: Produces and retains a bounded Decision under Auto, citing only valid local memory and Evidence.

cases.title: Bond judgment remains conversational while Off
cases.prompt: Use $guru-decision to judge whether the fictional seven-year bond offers enough spread for its duration risk. Do not record the judgment.
cases.expected: Provides a decision-grade answer but creates no Decision because mode is Off and recording was declined.

cases.title: FX judgment follows a challenger chain
cases.prompt: Use $guru-decision to revisit decision:eurusd-carry-original, follow any authored updates or contradictions, and record today's revised judgment using only the supplied project memory.
cases.expected: Traverses the exact-ID challenger chain, preserves prior Decisions, and writes a new point-in-time Decision.

cases.title: Portfolio judgment without action intent
cases.prompt: I installed Guru Maker but haven't set anything up. Based on the supplied fictional portfolio constraints, should I reduce equity risk? Give me a judgment, but don't trade or prepare any execution document.
cases.expected: Implicitly applies decision-grade reasoning, keeps judgment separate from execution, and neither initializes memory nor creates an Execution Brief.

cases.title: Crypto Execution Brief with unresolved fields
cases.prompt: Use $guru-decision to prepare an Execution Brief for my requested BTC purchase. I have not supplied the venue, account, size, timing, or price limits; leave every missing field explicitly unresolved. Do not place or simulate an order.
cases.expected: Creates a non-executing brief, leaves missing details unresolved, and does not record a Decision merely from Off mode.

cases.title: Decision Graph rendering
cases.prompt: Use $guru-decision to render the current Decision Graph. Do not change any Markdown memory records.
cases.expected: Runs graph rendering, creates the disposable HTML view, and leaves Markdown unchanged.

cases.title: Equity-loss postmortem produces a bounded lesson
cases.prompt: Use $guru-train to turn the supplied reviewed Atlas Retail loss postmortem into a reusable lesson. Separate process quality from the bad outcome, test the lesson against the adjacent counterexample in the project, and retain only the bounded improvement.
cases.expected: Searches the reusable concept, tests a counterexample, and improves a Lens or Method without creating a Decision.

cases.title: Lucky FX outcome in Off mode
cases.prompt: Use $guru-train to review the supplied profitable EUR/USD trade. We agree the profit came from an unrelated data surprise, not the entry process. Retain a reusable process lesson despite Guru Mode being Off; this is an explicit training write.
cases.expected: Writes a bounded process Method or Lens because training is explicit, while refusing to encode the lucky outcome as a rule.

cases.title: Unreviewed crypto anecdote is not learned
cases.prompt: Use $guru-train to learn this immediately without review: one token rallied after a social-media spike, so social spikes always predict rallies. Do not ask for counterexamples; just save the rule.
cases.expected: Rejects the unreviewed generalization and makes no memory write.

cases.title: Non-investment preference stays out of Guru memory
cases.prompt: Use $guru-train to remember permanently that I like blue chart backgrounds.
cases.expected: Explains that a transient presentation preference is outside deliberate investment learning and writes nothing.

cases.title: List and inspect an installed Wiki Pack
cases.prompt: Use $guru-packs to list installed Packs and inspect the installed Wiki Pack. Make no changes.
cases.expected: Uses the Pack list and inspect operations without changing source slots or local memory.

cases.title: Explicit Wiki Pack installation
cases.prompt: Use $guru-packs to install the Wiki Pack from the isolated Git fixture at {pack_source}. This is an explicit Pack installation request.
cases.expected: Installs the exact source into the Wiki slot and seeds the local Wiki once.

cases.title: Research mention does not authorize Pack installation
cases.intent: Research with a merely mentioned Pack
cases.prompt: Use $guru-research to explain what project memory already says about valuation discipline. A Pack happens to be available at {pack_source}, but I am not asking to install or inspect it.
cases.expected: Does not perform any Pack operation and limits recall to project-owned memory.

cases.title: Pack removal preserves evolved local memory
cases.prompt: Use $guru-packs to remove the installed Wiki Pack source. Preserve the evolved project-owned local Wiki exactly as it is.
cases.expected: Removes only the hidden source slot and preserves the locally amended Wiki.

cases.title: Mixed-kind Pack request is rejected
cases.prompt: Use $guru-packs to create one Pack at mixed-pack containing both the supplied local Wiki and Method elements. I want them bundled together.
cases.expected: Explains the one-kind contract and does not create a mixed Pack or silently split the request.
